name: hidx_sel_g4-g4-COMMIT
purpose: IDX-SMALL 10-18: d4g re-kit of the stack-shared selector idx_sel (hidx_sel_pr: 317x1164 um 3.7:1, ~7.2k pins on a partial W face at 10.4 pins/um, 5 CTS roots + 12 SRAM clock entries, never gated). Now the d4g slot outline 600x450 um; ONE clock root clk_ctl for every flop and SRAM (RTL shell: clk_q/clk_mem ports kept, unloaded); 12 SRAM 256x256 as two abutted 6-high N-S stacks (q0/q1 R0 pins W, q2/q3 MY pins E, 20.3-um channel between the PG-carrying back faces) flush to the bare N face; one U-shaped std-cell band (W/E strips + S band); pins on full faces <= 5.8/um: W in_line + control + observes, E clock (SE end) + selected_line, S out_line. Benches run_selector.sh SHELL=1 on the die master: MUT0 pass / MUT1 (ties >=) / MUT2 (emitted ID) fail.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hbm_idx_selector_static u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/index/ot_hbm_idx_selector_static.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_256x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: selector_exact
bench.pass_regex: IDX_SELECTOR_STATIC SHELL1 MUT0 frame2 checked512 errors0 fault0
